name: Anna Livia Plurabelle
text: Anna Livia Plurabelle is the name that the writer James Joyce gives to the river Liffey in Dublin. MacKillop points the reader to the entry for the Liffey. The river appears in Joyce's work as a woman of the stream.

attributes.attribute: Joyce's name for the river Liffey

key_results: Credit the name to James Joyce.
